ShortDescription.Value: Pin the money tooltip above the toolbar - keep your finance trend always visible with a single click.

PublishConfiguration.LongDescription:
The vanilla money tooltip only shows while you hover the money balance. This mod adds a small trend button next to it that keeps the tooltip pinned above the bottom toolbar.
**Features**
- Toggle button right next to the money balance in the bottom toolbar - Pinned panel shows the current money trend (income/loss per hour), just like the vanilla hover tooltip - Detailed monthly income and expense breakdown by category, with category color legends - All labels follow your game language - Collapses automatically when you press ESC (pause menu), load a savegame or start a new game - Pure UI mod: no savegame data is touched, safe to add or remove at any time
Made for game version 1.6.2f1.
---
在底部工具栏的资金数字旁新增一个趋势按钮。点击后，资金提示（当前走势）与收入/支出分类明细将常驻显示在资金栏上方，再次点击即可收起。
- 收支分类明细与原版经济面板预算页同源，带分类色块 - 全部文案跟随游戏语言 - 按 ESC 打开菜单、读取存档、开始新游戏时自动收起 - 纯界面模组，不写入任何存档数据，可随时安全启用/禁用
PublishConfiguration.ChangeLog:
Added support for the Legacy UI and the Console (gamepad) UI. The pin button now appears next to the money balance in all three toolbar styles (new, legacy and console).
新增经典版 UI 与手柄风格 UI（Console UI）支持：趋势按钮在新版、经典版、手柄版三套工具栏下均可正常显示，面板功能不变。
